processSection.title: How the engagement is organized
processSection.sidebarTitle: The process is presented as a route of analysis, strategy, and implementation, not as an automatic result promise.

processCards.title: 1. Initial WhatsApp contact
processCards.description: Context, urgency, matter type, and the practical objective are confirmed before requesting sensitive documents.

processCards.title: 2. Legal and document research
processCards.description: Facts, documents, laws, criteria, and useful analogies are reviewed to understand the real margin of action.

processCards.title: 3. Preventive or defense strategy
processCards.description: A route is proposed with priorities, dependencies, and scenarios depending on whether the matter requires prevention, negotiation, defense, or litigation.

processCards.title: 4. Implementation and follow-through
processCards.description: Support advances with responsible parties, visible pending items, and adjustments when facts, authorities, or counterparties change.

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.subtitle: General answers to orient the first contact without replacing individualized legal advice.

faq.title: Does the first WhatsApp message create an attorney-client relationship?
faq.content: No. First contact helps understand the context and decide whether there is a service route. A professional relationship requires express acceptance and agreed conditions.

faq.title: What should be prepared before writing?
faq.content: Main facts, dates, documents, communications, payments, contracts, or any evidence that explains the issue without exposing unnecessary information.

faq.title: Do you support foreign investment and Chinese companies?
faq.content: Yes, the brief prioritizes soft landing for Chinese companies that seek to invest or operate in Mexico. The concrete scope is confirmed after reviewing the matter.

faq.title: Can a result be guaranteed?
faq.content: No. The page must avoid absolute promises. The service may provide analysis, strategy, defense, and follow-through, but outcomes depend on facts, evidence, authorities, and applicable law.
